jobs.title: Back-End Engineer (Senior)
jobs.description:
**Description**

  

### **About Xe**

Xe is a cross-border payments platform. We help SMEs and consumers in the US, UK, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand collect, convert, hold, and send money across markets. Each year, over 300 million people use Xe for currency information and over 350,000 use us to send money overseas.

Today, we're rebuilding the platform layer behind cross-border payments for corporate and consumer clients. We're small enough that your code ships fast and your decisions matter, and Euronet Worldwide (Nasdaq: EEFT) backs us so the problems stay real-scale.

### **About This Role**

We're hiring a senior back-end engineer who owns real problems end-to-end and shapes how the team builds, from API design and data modeling through to service implementation, production reliability, and launch. You already use AI as part of how you think, build, test, and ship.

You'll write code that moves money in production, design and modernize the backend services the platform runs on, and lead delivery of new capability as Xe rebuilds its platform layer. You'll work in a small team with direct access to product, compliance, and operations, own architecture in your domain, lead design reviews, mentor mid-level engineers, and partner with architects and team leads on cross-domain decisions.

### **What You'll Do**

* Design and own backend services that move money and manage multi-currency balances across a range of domains, including onboarding, KYC and KYB, payment initiation, FX, settlement, and other supporting services.
* Lead cross-functional delivery with product, compliance, and operations from problem framing through launch.
* Lead the build of the partner integrations and settlement infrastructure your domain depends on.
* Own production health for your domain, including reliability, observability, on-call, and incident response.
* Lead design reviews, set technical direction for your domain, and mentor mid-level engineers.
* Use agentic coding tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent) daily across the SDLC, and lead modernization from legacy services into the modern stack alongside architects and team leads in your domain.

### **What We're Looking For**

**Must-have**

* 6 to 10+ years building production backend services, end-to-end.
* Strong backend proficiency in C# / .NET preferred; other OOP languages welcome (Java, Kotlin, Go, or equivalent).
* SQL and relational database fundamentals.
* Writing and maintaining tests.
* Daily use of agentic coding tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent) across the SDLC.
* Production experience with AWS, including hands-on deployment, CI/CD pipelines and modern deployment practices, and native services such as SQS, DynamoDB, S3, ECS, and Lambda.
* Strong system design and architecture experience, including service-oriented or microservices and event-driven patterns.
* Payments, FX, or regulated-industry experience.
* Track record of technical leadership: mentoring engineers, leading design reviews, and making architecture decisions in your domain.
* Strong written and verbal communication.

**Nice-to-have**

* Experience with ledgers, double-entry accounting, or other financial-data systems.
* Experience hiring, interviewing, or onboarding engineers.
* Experience leading modernization or platform migrations.
* Experience with caching solutions like Memcached or Redis.
* Experience using project management and documentation tools like Jira and Confluence.
* Knowledge of API testing tools such as Postman or Bruno.
* Writing automated tests alongside development with AI tools (Claude Code or equivalent).

### **Perks & Benefits**

* Competitive Salary & Discretionary Bonus
* 23 days annual leave increasing with service (capped at 28 days)
* Paid day off for your Birthday
* 4% employer pension contribution
* Discounted Euronet ESPP
* Life Cover, Income Protection & Critical Illness cover
* Healthcare
* Plumm Mental Health and Wellbeing
* Volunteering day for a charity of your choice

We want Xe to be a great place to work and to ensure that our communities are represented across our workforce. A vital part of this is ensuring we are a truly inclusive organization that encourages diversity in all respects.

Xe is an **Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment regardless of age, national origin, race, color, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.** We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at recruitment@xe.com.

The position responsibilities outlined above are intended to define the general contents and requirements to perform this job. It is not to be taken as a complete statement of responsibilities or requirements. This job description does not restrict the Company's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job as needed.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**About the job**

We are seeking skilled senior level .NET Fleet Management Software Developer with background in robotics / automation to join us in developing our automated warehouse software.

**What we offer**

Moffett Automation is an award-winning high-tech company. We are steadily expanding due to our successful product infiltrating the market. We are an industry leader in what we do which is developing software and producing automated pallet shuttles and other products to move pallets around a warehouse. We dedicate time to R&D for new features and products so there is always something new to be working on and that we are keeping ahead of the curve.

We have developed our software fully in-house, and it consists of three main components: Warehouse Control System Software, Machine Software (Shuttles, Lifts and Conveyors) and Frontend (and Backend). We use .NET Core and .NET 6 for all our software and Blazor for our frontend user interfaces.

As each project we take on is unique, we are always working on new features which test our software team whilst also looking to improve current system. You will get to test your code on real machines in our factory in Monaghan where we have our own automated warehouse just for our testing purposes. Our software is largely about reading sensors and controlling motors and actuators according to orders from our control system.

**Who we are looking for**

Primarily we are seeking mid to senior level developers who can understand and improve our existing algorithms for fleet management and order scheduling logic and create new ones to optimise the efficiency of different setups.

**Must have skills**:

· .NET / C#

· Experience in the industry or similar industry

· Strong capability to understand and develop algorithms

· Experience with the use of state machines

· Excellent problem solver

· Control systems experience

**Experience with any of the following would be an advantage:**

· Automation of hardware/machinery

· Electrical/mechanical knowledge is highly advantageous

· Warehouse Control systems/ Warehouse Management systems

· SQL

**Salary and benefits**

· Compensation depends solely on the skills and qualities of the person

· Pension scheme

· Flexible hybrid working

· Time and resources for personal development

· Death in Benefit

· Employee Assistance Programme

· Free parking

· On-site recreational facilities

Benefits:

* Additional leave
* Company events
* Company pension
* Employee assistance program
* Flexitime
* On-site parking

Experience:

* .NET: 4 years (required)
* C#: 4 years (required)

Work authorisation:

* Ireland (required)

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Senior Observability Engineer
jobs.description:
**Responsibilities:**  
Administer the log and search platform (currently Splunk Cloud): indexes, data onboarding, roles and access, apps and knowledge objects, retention, and search and dashboard performance. Monitor ingest latency, skipped searches and licence consumption, and tune to keep cost under control.
  
  
Administer the APM, RUM and infrastructure monitoring platform (currently Splunk Observability Cloud): teams, tokens, integrations, detectors, alert routing and dashboards. Manage metric cardinality and usage against entitlement.
  
  
**Roll out telemetry to all IS applications:** OpenTelemetry Collector (currently the Splunk distribution) on AWS EKS and EC2, and APM instrumentation for Java, Go, .NET, Node.js and Python. Keep instrumentation vendor-neutral where possible so the backend can change without re-instrumenting. Maintain onboarding guides and report coverage per application.
  
  
Set up RUM for customer-facing web and mobile frontends and link browser sessions to backend traces, logs and infrastructure metrics, so an incident can be followed from the user to the data store.
  
  
Build and maintain observability as code (Terraform or equivalent) in Git with peer review and CI/CD, so detectors, dashboards and configuration are versioned, repeatable and free of manual drift.
  
  
**Plan and run platform and agent upgrades with vendors:** define the test plan, validate in non-production, sign off before release, and manage support cases and escalations. Run structured evaluations and proofs of concept when StarHub considers a new or replacement tool.
  
  
Design, build and operate AI and agent-assisted observability workflows, such as alert noise reduction, automated triage, root-cause summaries and natural-language querying, with human review and guardrails.
  
  
Apply controls aligned with MAS-TRM and CSA best practices to telemetry: retention, access control, audit logging, and masking of PII and sensitive data before ingest.
  
  
Perform User Access Reviews (UAR) on the observability platforms at least twice a year, covering user accounts, roles and tokens, and follow up on removals and exceptions. Participate in company-wide audits when required, providing evidence and closing findings on time.
  
  
Qualifications
  
  
**Minimum Profile/ Track Record:**  
Desired Background
  
  
Experience in medium-to-large technology, telecommunications or financial services organizations with complex hybrid-cloud environments and many application teams; has owned an enterprise observability platform, not only used one.
  
  
Seniority, Skills, Certifications (must-haves)
  
  
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related field.
  
  
5+ years of relevant experience in observability, monitoring, SRE or platform engineering, including hands-on administration, optimization and health monitoring of an enterprise observability or log analytics platform. Splunk (Cloud or Enterprise) is strongly preferred.
  
  
Hands-on experience with an enterprise APM/RUM/infrastructure monitoring platform across RUM, APM, infrastructure and data-storage monitoring. Splunk Observability Cloud is preferred; Datadog, Dynatrace, New Relic, Elastic or similar is acceptable. Clear understanding of distributed tracing from frontend to backend.
  
  
Experience installing and operating OpenTelemetry-based telemetry on AWS (EKS, EC2) for Java, Go, .NET, Node.js and Python applications.
  
  
Experience managing observability configuration as code (Terraform or equivalent, Git, CI/CD).
  
  
Prior AI delivery experience in observability or IT operations: has taken an AI or agent-based capability into production use by operations or engineering teams.
  
  
Familiarity with security and compliance standards (MAS-TRM, CSA), including telemetry data governance.
  
  
**Certifications are a plus:** Splunk Core Certified Admin or Power User, Splunk Observability Cloud certification, or equivalent vendor certifications on another observability platform.
  
  
Ideal track record #1
  
  
Owned an enterprise observability or log analytics platform at scale (Splunk preferred) as administrator and platform owner, improving search performance, stability or ingest cost, and ran vendor-led upgrades with test and validation plans and no unplanned outage.
  
  
Ideal track record #2
  
  
Rolled out APM and infrastructure telemetry (OpenTelemetry) across a large application estate with RUM-to-backend tracing in use during real incidents, measurably reducing time to detect or resolve.
  
  
Ideal track record #3
  
  
Delivered an AI or agent-based capability in production for monitoring, triage or root-cause analysis, with measurable impact such as less alert noise or faster resolution.
  
  
To APPLY NOW, click on Skye!
